tools.name: skill
tools.description: Access development documentation. Pass a skill alias to get that documentation. Pass 'index' or no argument to list all available skills.

alias.description: Skill alias (e.g., 'aws', 'tests'). Omit or use 'index' to list all skills.

tools.name: version
tools.description: Prints the current version and hash, `@jaypie/mcp@0.8.60#21fed95d`

tools.name: release_notes
tools.description: Browse Jaypie package release notes. Commands: list, read. Call with no args for help.

tools.name: datadog
tools.description: Access Datadog observability data. Commands: logs, log_analytics, monitors, synthetics, metrics, rum. Call with no args for help.

aggregation.description: Aggregation type for log_analytics (count, avg, sum, min, max, cardinality)

command.description: Command to execute: logs, log_analytics, monitors, synthetics, metrics, rum (omit for help)

from.description: Start time (e.g., now-1h, now-15m, now-1d, or ISO 8601 timestamp)

groupBy.description: Fields to group by for log_analytics (comma-separated, e.g., service,status)

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

status.description: Monitor status filter (comma-separated: Alert, Warn, No Data, OK)

testId.description: Synthetic test ID for getting results

to.description: End time (e.g., now, or ISO 8601 timestamp)

type.description: Synthetic test type filter (api or browser)
